## About
ABC Automotive & Electronics started with a Chicago police officer, James Faust, Sr., who saw vehicle thefts and break-ins on the rise and began building and installing his own security systems. Today the business is run by his sons, Jim and John Faust.
We install remote starts, security and sound systems in cars, vans, trucks, RVs, boats, motorcycles and commercial vehicles. The work has grown to include custom audio, mobile video, vehicle safety, emergency and first responder solutions, restyling, and truck and car accessories.
Our Berwyn shop is on Ogden Ave. Give us a call or stop by and tell us what you have in mind for your vehicle.

## Services
- Remote start and security: Remote start and security systems installed in all types of vehicles. One reviewer had a Viper remote start installed and said Neil walked him through the different options.
- Car audio: Speakers, amps, subwoofers and custom audio. One customer said his new sound system turned out exactly as he hoped.
- Dashcams: Dashcam systems installed professionally, with the wiring tucked out of sight.
- Vehicle safety and first responder solutions: Safety equipment plus emergency and first responder solutions for working vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, vans, trucks, RVs, boats, motorcycles and commercial vehicles.

Q: Is there another ABC location?
A: Yes. ABC Elk Grove Village is at 1401 Landmeier Road, Elk Grove, IL 60007. You can reach them at 847-364-6700.
